title: What Rockstar confirmed in October
note: Pre-launch reveals from 1–22 October 2026. tier: confirmed = Rockstar first-party or a Rockstar developer on record; reported = third-party report (rating board page since removed, journalist paraphrase, anonymous sources). items.title: Six radio stations with celebrity hosts
items.detail: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics — hosted by Bad Bunny, Lana Del Rey, Morgan Wallen, Burna Boy, Kerry King, Robyn, Trick Daddy, Trina and more.

items.title: Podcasts and earbuds on foot
items.detail: On-demand podcasts beyond terrestrial radio. Radio and podcasts play in vehicles and on foot through headphones and earbuds connected to Jason and Lucia's smartphones.
items.quote: a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida's terrestrial radio

items.title: 34-track album on Nov 19 and a Justice score
items.detail: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album ships on launch day. Justice composed the original dynamic score; their single 'Flower in a Hurricane' debuted in the Launch Trailer.

items.title: Launch Trailer captured in-game on PS5
items.detail: The 90-second Launch Trailer's end card states it was captured entirely in-game on a standard PlayStation 5.

items.title: Text and call the other protagonist
items.detail: While playing as one protagonist you can text or call the other at any time. Ignoring their messages slightly hurts the relationship.

items.title: Read-only social media
items.detail: You can follow accounts and browse posts in-game, but Jason and Lucia can't post.

items.title: Unplanned encounters with choices
items.detail: Demo example: a man in a dumpster asks Lucia for pills. Help him and he later returns with legal advice.

items.title: Sweat scales with exertion
items.detail: A scripted system makes characters sweat more the harder they work — dancing hard in a nightclub produces more sweat than standing still.

items.title: Lucia's hometown is Liberty City
items.detail: Writer Alexa D'Agostino based Lucia on women she knows; her mother grew up in Newark, 'close to Lucia's hometown of Liberty City'.
items.quote: That's how you get a woman that can stand tall next to the likes of Arthur Morgan and Niko Bellic.

items.title: Raul Bautista is the older mentor
items.detail: Raul embodies the local and criminal knowledge of Vice City that Jason and Lucia lack when they arrive.

items.title: Two flawed, equal protagonists
items.detail: Writer Elizabeth Gauvey-Kern on Jason and Lucia.
items.quote: We wanted both protagonists to be vulnerable, tough, flawed, right sometimes, wrong sometimes, able to learn from each other.

items.title: Elections, robocalls and political talk radio
items.detail: SVP of Narrative Rupert Humphries: you'll 'see a sign for an election, receive a robocall from a campaign, or hear a commercial on the radio', plus political talk shows.

items.title: A dedicated pedestrian-dialogue team
items.detail: A new LA writing team focused only on pedestrian dialogue, plus advertising and comedy writers in New York, LA and London.

items.title: Carry and use cocaine at any time
items.detail: PEGI's report said the player can carry cocaine and snort it from their hand at any time.

items.title: Interactive private dances in nightclubs
items.detail: Players can pay for private dances in nightclubs, per the PEGI descriptor.

items.title: Domestic animals in the world
items.detail: Domestic animals appear in the environment and can be harmed, without the injury detail applied to humans.

items.title: Dismemberment with certain weapons
items.detail: Violence is 'bloody with a high degree of realism'; certain weapons can cause decapitation and dismemberment.

items.title: In-game purchases — optional
items.detail: The rating line on Rockstar's own GTA VI pages lists 'In-Game Purchases'. PEGI's removed report added that the game can be played without buying them.

items.title: PC version targeted for Q1 2027
items.detail: GamesBeat cites four industry sources with business ties to Rockstar. Not announced by Rockstar.
